stage_test: tests/stages/kuna-arm-float-return.xml (16 assertions: raw image control, relocatable object and linked fmtlf_armhf with the option off and on, plus the bump/second/w2 controls)

measurement.method: min of N interleaved runs of origin/main, this branch with the option off, and on

decbench_hard_float_firmware.note: 12 in libgcc __gnu_Unwind_{Save,Restore}_VFP{,_D} stubs, 2 of their callers' local types, 2 data words decoded as code

limitations: Opt-in; scalar only (a struct of doubles or _Complex double returns only its first member); a double argument at a call needs a declared or protoorder-recovered callee prototype; two floats read as the halves of d0 below a used VFP parameter keep that slot as one 8-byte parameter; a float result and a deliberate low-word edit of a double look alike and the latter needs an explicit double return. See analysis.md.
